nom: ANUA PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Booster Toner

avis.texte: I've really been enjoying this toner. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and smooth without any stickiness. I've noticed my skin looks plumper and healthier, especially when I use it together with my Medicube Booster Pro. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I would definitely repurchase it!
